defective_pattern: Including parenthetical Latin (English) words inline within running Persian narrative text.
why_defective: Violates strict Persian typography rules (Directive 5). Latin characters disrupt RTL paragraph layout and bi-directional text alignment, breaking formal scholarly presentation.
observed_symptoms: English text inside parentheses scattered across Persian paragraphs.
corrective_remedy: All foreign terms must be translated or transliterated to Persian in the main text. The original English terminology must be strictly placed in native OpenXML footnotes.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Regex detection of Latin characters in Persian markdown or DOCX narrative blocks.
